# GPT-Policy

In-Context Robot Learning with VLM Agents

**2026-09-16 · Preprint · Not reported**

**[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19138)** · [Project](https://cheng-haha.github.io/GPT-Policy) · [Code](https://github.com/cheng-haha/GPT-Policy) · [Data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/SII-CDZ/gpt-policy-robodojo-contexts)

A frozen VLM combines task references, current observations and persistent interaction history to select constrained Cartesian robot tools.

<img src="../../../website/public/images/catalog/gpt-policy-policy.webp" width="760" alt="Figure 2: A frozen VLM combines task references, current observations and persistent interaction history to select constrained Cartesian robot tools."/>

**Scope and qualifications**

- The sample size is small, and progress scores and binary task success are different metrics.
- Absolute Cartesian waypoint tools differ from RoboICL's fixed-rate incremental action-matrix interface.
